name: Bathran's Haunt
summary: Forsaken herbalists harvest rare plants at Bathran's Haunt, east of the Zoram Strand in northwestern Ashenvale. Their work is withering the woodland around the ancient kaldorei ruin.

sections.title: A Blighted Refuge in the Ancient Woods
sections.body: Crumbling night elf pillars rise north of the Ruins of Ordil'Aran, caught in Ashenvale's thick foliage. Once a tranquil kaldorei relic, Bathran's Haunt now shelters Forsaken herbalists and their enforcers. They work among broken marble in an open-air laboratory, gathering rare woodland reagents for experiments. As they harvest, grass rots brown and blossoms wilt. Decay creeps through the grove, blighting the ancient soil.

sections.title: The Harvest of Bathran's Hair
sections.body: Bathran's Hair grows only among these stones, and it is a unique remedial herb. Night elf and Alliance scouts see its harvest as desecration of sacred elven soil. Forsaken herbalists seek the plant's potent properties, and the Horde has an interest in its yield. Yet the Forsaken keep their methods secret. The corrupted earth draws suspicion from outsiders and allies alike.

aliases: how to get to bathrans haunt
faq.answer: Bathran's Haunt lies in northwestern Ashenvale, north of the Ruins of Ordil'Aran and inland to the east of the Zoram Strand.

aliases: what are undead doing in ashenvale
why are forsaken at bathrans haunt
faq.answer: Forsaken herbalists have made an encampment and laboratory among the ruins. They gather and study the forest's unique plants, especially Bathran's Hair, a rare remedial herb.
Bathran's Hair is a distinctive remedial herb with potent restorative qualities. It grows only among the crumbling stones of Bathran's Haunt.

faq.q: Why is the ground dying around the ruins?
faq.answer: The Forsaken's presence and alchemical work have corrupted the ground near the ruins. Grass withers brown, and woodland flowers die.

angles.text: As a night elf, you may see the Forsaken encampment at Bathran's Haunt as a defilement of kaldorei heritage. Undead intruders occupy ancient elven stonework and blight sacred soil.
As an herbalist, you know Bathran's Haunt as the only known home of Bathran's Hair, a unique remedial herb sought for its rare restorative properties.
